text: Healthy living is about taking care of both your body and your mind. First, you should eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Regular exercise is also important, so try to be active for at least thirty minutes a day. Getting enough sleep helps your body recover and improves your mood. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and spend time on things you enjoy. Finally, keep a good work-life balance so you don't feel stressed. Small daily habits can make a big difference to your health.
